rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: At the meeting, D. Medvedev (as labelled in the transcript) said that, in view of the constitutional changes the President had proposed in his Address that day, it would be right for the Government in its current composition to resign in accordance with Article 117 of the Constitution, and that further decisions would be taken by the President.

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Putin thanked the Government and asked its members to carry out their duties in full until a Government in a new composition is formed.
